text:
marie: Heads-up — rolling 560.32 driver+kernel patch to the Orbit GPU fleet (us-west1 + eu-central). Started at 08:12 UTC and we've seen DKMS rebuild failures leaving some nodes in initramfs drop. Affects 3/60 nodes so far. Ticket INF-2389: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2389
vikram: Can you paste the dkms/make log from one of the failed nodes?
marie: Pasted from /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/560.32/build/make.log:
```
DKMS make.log for kernel 5.15.0-1023-gcp (x86_64)
make[1]: Entering directory '/usr/src/linux-headers-5.15.0-1023-gcp'
...
ERROR: modpost: "nvmap_create" [nvidia.ko] undefined!
make[2]: *** [scripts/Makefile.modpost:110: __modpost] Error 1
```
sasha: That error pattern usually means the compiled module is picking up the wrong kernel headers (ABI mismatch). Which AMI image are these nodes running?
marie: orbit-2025-04-01-base image with CUDA 11.8 overlay. We pinned kernel to 5.15 but some nodes drifted to 5.15.12 due to unattended-upgrades on a subset.
james: Can we cordon those nodes and reimage them? Also want to avoid autoscaler churn — how many pods are on those nodes?
marie: Cordoned the 3 nodes (orbit-gpu-12/34/78), draining with pod eviction in progress. Started reimage via /ops/reimage command. Quick note: cluster-autoscaler flagged insufficient capacity for some GPU instance types while drain is running.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback triggered for driver-rollout/560.32 — staging set to stop further node pushes.
vikram: Short-term workaround: install the prebuilt nvidia kernel module package (nvidia-driver-local) on the failed nodes or run the installer with --no-dkms and use precompiled modules until AMIs are fixed. Alternative: ensure /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build points to the correct headers before dkms build.
sasha: Long-term fix: bake DKMS-built modules into the AMI, or pin kernel headers and disable unattended kernel upgrades on GPU images. Also add a preflight that verifies the build of the nvidia module against current headers during rollout.
marie: Filed INF-2390 for AMI bake changes and INF-2391 for rollout preflight/alerting. Put notes in the rollout doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2390
james: No external customer impact observed yet (3 nodes, autoscaled around). Monitoring heap and pod evictions. I'll keep this thread open until the 3 nodes are reimaged and driver-rollout is green. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: infra-bot: anomaly detected — repeated dkms build failures during driver deployment in eu-central, creating alert INF-ALERT-6602.
marie: Update at 09:05 UTC: reimage completed on 3 nodes, DKMS now succeeds using baked kernel-headers. Rollout resumed to remainder of fleet with canary window extended.
james: Thanks everyone. Follow-up actions: pin kernel headers in orbit image, add DKMS preflight and alerting, and add a rollback playbook step to cordon+reimage. Closing this thread after postmortem notes added to INF-2389. :white_check_mark:
